What does the apostrophe in nǚ'ér do?
options: It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
mcq.explanation: The apostrophe separates nǚ and ér.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "On Saturday I rest at home."?
mcq.explanation: 我星期六在家休息。 (wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.) means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The rain is heavy."?
mcq.explanation: 雨很大。 (yǔ hěn dà.) means "The rain is heavy.".

mcq.q: Which sentence means "I use my mouth to speak."?
mcq.explanation: 我用嘴巴说。 (wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.) means "I use my mouth to speak.".

mcq.q: How many main tones does Mandarin have, not counting the neutral tone?
mcq.explanation: Mandarin has four main tones: high level, rising, dipping and falling.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "to play"?
Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday"?
Which stroke rule is used when writing 好?
options: Left part 女 before right part 子

mcq.q: What should you check on your display before a showcase?
options: Tone marks, stroke order, spelling and neat writing
mcq.explanation: Careful checking makes the display clear.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "drought"?
Which is a good step for reading a sentence at a good pace?
options: Read as fast as you can at once
Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
mcq.explanation: Slow reading first, then a natural speed.

mcq.q: What does 六 (liù) mean?

Which word is pronounced nín hǎo?
mcq.explanation: 您好 is pronounced nín hǎo and means hello (polite).

mcq.q: How is 你好 nǐ hǎo really said?
mcq.explanation: Two third tones together: the first changes to the second tone.

mcq.q: How many strokes does 妈 have?
mcq.explanation: 女 has 3 strokes and 马 has 3.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 电视在桌子上____? (Is the television on the table?)
mcq.explanation: 吗 turns the statement into a yes-or-no question.

mcq.q: What is pinyin?
options: A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters
mcq.explanation: Pinyin uses the same letters as English and Kiswahili to show how Mandarin sounds.

mcq.q: What does 星期一到星期五,我上学 mean?
options: On Sunday, I rest at home
From Monday to Friday, I go to school
I go to school on Saturday
mcq.explanation: 到 is to, and 上学 is go to school.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "mother"?
Which sentence means "My name is Xiaoming."?
mcq.explanation: 我叫小明。 (wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.) means "My name is Xiaoming.".

mcq.q: Which sentence means "This is a banana."?
mcq.explanation: 这是香蕉。 (zhè shì xiāngjiāo.) means "This is a banana.".

Which Chinese word means "tea"?
Which sentence means "This is my father."?
mcq.explanation: 这是我爸爸。 (zhè shì wǒ bàba.) means "This is my father.".

mcq.q: What does 饼 (bǐng) mean?
Fill the blank: 冰箱____厨房。 (The fridge is in the kitchen.)
mcq.explanation: 在 means is at or is in.

What does 二 (èr) mean?

options: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
mcq.explanation: Listening and copying the tone shapes helps you speak clearly.

The fridge is in the kitchen.

mcq.q: Which word is pronounced wǎnfàn?
mcq.explanation: 晚饭 is pronounced wǎnfàn and means dinner.

mcq.q: What does 下 (xià) mean?
Which of these is a staple food that gives the body energy?
mcq.explanation: Staple foods such as rice give energy.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "My friend gives me a gift."?
mcq.explanation: 朋友送我礼物。 (péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.) means "My friend gives me a gift.".

mcq.q: What does 和 (hé) mean?
Read the pinyin: nà shì wǒ gēge. What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: nà shì wǒ gēge. is 那是我哥哥。, which means "That is my older brother.".

mcq.q: What does 没有 méiyǒu mean?
mcq.explanation: 没有 is the opposite of 有.

mcq.q: What does 午饭 (wǔfàn) mean?

What does decoding a word mean?
options: Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it

mcq.q: What do the three words 早饭, 午饭 and 晚饭 have in common?
mcq.explanation: 饭 is meal, and the first characters tell the time of day.

mcq.q: On which vowel does the tone mark go in nǐ?

mcq.explanation: 风很大。 (fēng hěn dà.) means "The wind is very strong.".

mcq.q: Why do we read greetings with a friendly face?
options: It changes the voice to sound friendly
mcq.explanation: A smile changes the sound of your voice.

mcq.q: In reading aloud, what is stress?
options: Saying an important word a little stronger
mcq.explanation: Stress makes key words stand out but does not change the tone.

mcq.q: What does the broken telephone game teach?
mcq.explanation: A whispered word can change when a listener misses a sound or tone.

mcq.q: What does 谁 (shéi) mean?
What does 你 (nǐ) mean?
What does 我用耳朵听 mean?
options: I use my ears to hear
I use my eyes to see
I use my mouth to speak
I use my hands to write
mcq.explanation: 耳朵 is ears and 听 is hear.

mcq.q: What does 菠菜 (bōcài) mean?

mcq.explanation: 月 is month and 号 is the date.

mcq.q: What does 里 (lǐ) mean?

mcq.explanation: Horizontal comes before vertical when they cross.

mcq.q: What is special about Mandarin words for brothers and sisters?
options: They are all the same word
There are different words for older and younger ones
They are only used by adults
mcq.explanation: Mandarin has gēge and dìdi, jiějie and mèimei.

mcq.q: Which sentence do we use to name a weather picture?
mcq.explanation: 这是 + word names what we see.
